purpose: Prevent one match_session from growing into large raw-state artifacts while preserving enough evidence for live coaching and review.

default_retention.transient_visual_frame_policy: delete after host response; delete by TTL if the response never arrives

persist_during_match: pending visual requests without frame bytes

debug_exceptions.raw_frames: transient by default; explicit calibration samples only
debug_exceptions.full_state_retention: allowed only with --retain-full-state or equivalent debug flag

acceptance_rules: Normal cruise pipeline output must redact full standardized_live_state unless explicitly requested.
Postgame summary writer must not store screenshots, full raw logs, or full live_state.
Visual sensing may temporarily persist one host-model image input, but must delete it after host response or by TTL.
Runtime JSON must be Node-written UTF-8 without BOM.
UI must display host-model final advice, not backend scorer drafts.
note: The historical 81MB session shape is treated as a debug/raw retention smell. Product runtime should keep compact structured state and rotate review summaries.
